note: Successful soft landings on the Moon. Latitude is north-positive, longitude is east-positive (-180..180), in degrees. 'approx' marks sites whose position has not been pinned down in LRO imagery or is quoted only to a few hundredths of a degree. 'time' is the touchdown time in UTC (HH:MM).

landings.name: Luna 9
landings.summary: First spacecraft to soft-land on the Moon and return pictures from the surface.

landings.name: Surveyor 1
landings.summary: First US soft landing; returned more than 11,000 images.

landings.name: Luna 13
landings.summary: Tested the mechanical properties of the lunar soil.

landings.name: Surveyor 3
landings.summary: Dug trenches with a sampling scoop; later visited by the Apollo 12 crew.

landings.name: Surveyor 5
landings.summary: First chemical analysis of lunar soil in place.

landings.name: Surveyor 6
landings.summary: First spacecraft to lift off from the lunar surface, in a short hop.

landings.name: Surveyor 7
landings.summary: Only Surveyor sent to the lunar highlands.

landings.name: Apollo 11
landings.summary: First crewed landing. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin spent about 21.5 hours on the surface.

landings.name: Apollo 12
landings.summary: Precision landing within walking distance of Surveyor 3.

landings.name: Luna 16
landings.summary: First robotic sample return from the Moon.

landings.name: Luna 17 / Lunokhod 1
landings.summary: Delivered Lunokhod 1, the first rover on another world.

landings.name: Apollo 14
landings.summary: Alan Shepard and Edgar Mitchell explored the Fra Mauro highlands.

landings.name: Apollo 15
landings.summary: First mission to carry the Lunar Roving Vehicle.

landings.name: Luna 20
landings.summary: Returned a highland soil sample to Earth.

landings.name: Apollo 16
landings.summary: Only crewed landing in the central lunar highlands.

landings.name: Apollo 17
landings.summary: Last crewed landing; included geologist Harrison Schmitt.

landings.name: Luna 21 / Lunokhod 2
landings.summary: Delivered Lunokhod 2, which drove about 39 km.

landings.name: Luna 23
landings.summary: Landed but tipped over, damaging the sample drill; no sample was returned.

landings.name: Luna 24
landings.summary: Last Soviet lunar mission; returned a 2-metre core sample.

landings.name: Chang'e 3 / Yutu
landings.summary: China's first soft landing, and the first by anyone since 1976.

landings.name: Chang'e 4 / Yutu-2
landings.summary: First soft landing on the far side of the Moon.

landings.name: Chang'e 5
landings.summary: Returned 1.7 kg of young mare basalt, the first lunar samples since 1976.

landings.name: Chandrayaan-3
landings.summary: India's first soft landing, with the Pragyan rover.

landings.name: SLIM
landings.summary: Japan's first soft landing; a pinpoint landing that ended nose-down.

landings.name: IM-1 Odysseus
landings.summary: First commercial soft landing; came to rest tilted but operated for days.

landings.name: Chang'e 6
landings.summary: First sample return from the far side of the Moon.

landings.name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
landings.summary: First fully successful commercial landing; operated for a full lunar day.

landings.name: IM-2 Athena
landings.summary: Reached the surface near the south pole but fell on its side in a crater and shut down within a day.
